permissionStrings.camera: Zinc Go scans the QR code of zinc dev, and the projects you run in it can use the camera.
permissionStrings.microphone: The projects you run in Zinc Go can record sound, for a call or a recorder.
permissionStrings.location: The projects you run in Zinc Go can ask where you are, for a map or a walk.
permissionStrings.motion: The projects you run in Zinc Go can read the motion sensors.
permissionStrings.net: Zinc Go talks to zinc dev and zinc device on your computer, on your network.
